signals.evidence: Community coordinator (רכז קהילה) actively engaged in coordinating emergency response and community support in northern border community
צח״י (community resilience volunteer corps) mobilized and coordinating with local council, emergency services, and IDF in response to security situation
Public shelters (מקלטים) operational and accessible to residents in northern border community
Residents entering shelters and safe rooms (ממ״ד) when alert sirens (אזעקה) sound in response to security threats
Community mobilizing material resources including food packages, medical supplies, and emergency equipment for vulnerable populations
Community members accessing psychological support services and trauma counseling through local welfare and mental health frameworks
Schools operating on modified schedule or remote learning due to security situation in northern border community
Residents assisting elderly population (קשישים) and people with disabilities (אוכלוסיה עם מוגבלויות) to reach shelters and access services
Community experiencing cumulative burnout (שחיקה) and stress from prolonged security situation and repeated alerts
Shortage of trained personnel for community support services and insufficient capacity in psychological support frameworks
Home Front Command (פיקוד העורף) providing clear alert protocols and shelter location information to residents
Community organizing informal support networks and relief activities (הפגה) for decompression and mutual aid
